title: Overview of the NLPCC 2025 Shared Task: Gender Bias Mitigation Challenge

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models on three challenges using the Chinese CORGI-PM dataset: binary gender bias detection, multi-label classification of gender stereotype subtypes (activities/careers, descriptions, attitudes/norms), and bias mitigation via sentence rewriting, assessed through automated N-gram metrics (BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR) and human evaluations.
